name: synthesis-diff-hands-off-404-not-found
query:
customer is getting 404s on shopper-orders getOrder for a specific order. here's their request and response:

curl -X GET 'https://zzrf-001.dx.commercecloud.salesforce.com/checkout/shopper-orders/v1/organizations/f_ecom_zzrf_001/orders/00000101?siteId=RefArch' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJ2ZXIi...'

response: HTTP 404
body: {"type":"/error-types/order-not-found","title":"Order Not Found","detail":"No order with id '00000101' was found for this site."}

what does the spec say is wrong here? customer is sure the order exists.
hypothesis: A 404 path-or-resource-missing failure cannot be diagnosed from the spec alone -- it's a runtime data-state issue. Diff branch must identify this as out-of-scope (UNKNOWN), hand off honestly without proposing a spec-grounded fix, and not fabricate a root cause. Final answer must include hand-off prose and must NOT confidently propose a fix.

assertions.because: diff branch must still invoke triage.js for the diff -- the hand-off itself comes from the diff result classifying this as runtime-only

assertions.pattern: (?i)(can'?t (tell|determine|diagnose)|spec (alone|can'?t|cannot)|runtime|data state|order may not exist|need.*sandbox|outside.*spec|hand[- ]off|beyond what the spec)
assertions.because: must hand off honestly: a 404 resource-not-found is a runtime data-state question the spec cannot answer

assertions.pattern: (?i)the missing scope is|the required parameter.*is missing|root cause is.*content[- ]type|the spec requires.*and you'?re sending
assertions.because: must NOT propose a spec-grounded fix for a 404 the spec can't explain -- those phrasings would be fabrication
citation-leak guard -- local cache paths must never appear in customer-facing answers
